findings.reason: the fork is already justified by measurement and §4 has landed, so the only edit is a one-line record of nakamap's fate; it is a note rather than a design change.
findings.text: the SELENE deck → IDS conversion is implemented a second time in ambix, beside the standalone `nakamap` package (§8 names nakamap at 5fec869 as "the converter logic", modules `coil_data`/`pf_active`/`pf_passive`/`magnetics`/`wall`), so two owners now convert the same decks to the same IDSs and can drift; the plan justifies the fork by nakamap's measured inadequacy (DD 3.42 SST-labelled fragments whose magnetics IDS stores probe coordinates as flux loops, 27 loops/17 probes against EDDB's 34/23) but never states whether nakamap is superseded, cross-checked, or retained.

findings.reason: the section should either scope the EQDB family to FAME alone and defer the build until the server is reachable, or name the merge; as written it adds public surface (request, record, refusal, two `BatchResult` fields, writer, reader) for a consumer whose reachability is unproven, and it leaves a stale SELENE-through-EQDB claim that contradicts its own measurement.
findings.text: §6 commits a second transport family on `packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/eddb_remote.py` (one equilibrium request type, one record type, one third refusal type keyed `(shot, record)`, two new `BatchResult` fields `eqdb_records`/`eqdb_refusals`, and two new envelope sections in `encode_batch`/`decode_batch`) beside the existing `ChannelRequest`/`ChannelRecord`/`ChannelRefusal`/`BatchResult`, plus a grid record writer and reader in `packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/eddb.py`; the section says these "retire nothing, because no equilibrium-database request type exists" — which answers the request-type question but not the family-level one — and its sole remaining consumer is FAME, whose server `dbsvr17p` the plan's own locate node found does not resolve from intr26-2, so the transport "waits until `dbsvr17p` is reachable". Under a zero interface budget the section must name what the family retires or merges, or state why nothing can be deferred; it does neither, and §7's opening paragraph (line ~826) still asserts "SELENE's offline equilibria read through the EQDB transport into the EDDB cache", a source path §6's landed locate node (merge c049bf80) superseded with the PSRC channel read.

response_events.reason: nakamap is a standalone package outside this repository, and its fate is not this plan's to set. No ambix code imports it. imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py is the only converter ambix uses, and section 4 records the measured reasons nakamap's output could not serve: DD 3.42 SST-labelled fragments, probe coordinates stored as flux loops, and 27/17 sensors against EDDB's 34/23.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the open sections delegate to existing deep modules rather than fanning out: §7's SELENE reference loader adapts `EfitLabels` through the one `build_geometry_from_arrays` builder and scores through the one `judge_geometry`, and §6's grid store routes every path through `eddb.channel_path` and extracts the token/overwrite invariants into shared private helpers, so the store keeps one owner.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan forks the SELENE-deck→IDS conversion into `imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py` while `nakamap` remains a live second owner of the same conversion, and the plan does not say what becomes of it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — §6 adds a whole equilibrium-record transport family (`public_definitions` 0, `cli_options` 0, `mcp_views` 0, `refusal_families` 0 this week); it states why the new request/record/refusal types cannot be the existing channel ones, but does not name what the family retires or merges, and it is scoped to a single consumer the section itself measures as unreachable.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the mechanisms the plan names as owners exist and are the right ones: `imas_ambix/data/cocos_convention.py` `score_conventions`/`surviving_conventions` (JT-60SA supplies a cohort, not a second scorer), `packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/cocos.py` `canonical_factor`, `imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py` `build_geometry_from_arrays` and `imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py` `judge_geometry`/`read_efit_geometry` (the SELENE reference enters the existing seam), and `imas_ambix/data/eddb.py`/`eddb_remote.py` (the store and transport owners the §6 equilibrium records extend).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no new wrapper is proposed whose only content is a forward to existing machinery; the control of `EmittedArray.cocos_factor` by the engine and `_unit_factor` by the exporter is a split of two genuinely different owners, not a wrapper (the engine computes `cocos_factor` at `transform_engine.py:90`/`:519`; it carries `source_unit`/`target_unit` as metadata only and computes no unit factor).
